definition: One published item — an essay, a data story, a game or a tool — signed by its author, with a permanent URL under its section
Where a piece lives, with a vernacular name: The Numbers, Classics, The Nets, The Long Room, Scorebook, The Archive
An ordered set of pieces on one theme, such as Rain Rules; it orders pieces but doesn't own their URLs
The match, player, competition and ground pages, served from D1 and covering everything in Cricsheet
The source of all match data (Stephen Rushe, ODC Attribution License 1.0), credited on every page that uses it
